WORLD: the harbour city of Saltmarrow.

CHARACTERS (canonical fact name for "is alive and reachable"):
- Oren Vask, pawnbroker on Fishmonger's Pier   -> alive_oren_vask
- Captain Hallowell, commands the Iron Watch    -> alive_hallowell
- Sister Dunmore, keeps the almshouse ledger    -> alive_dunmore

ITEMS (canonical fact name for "the player holds it"):
- the Sunburst Astrolabe -> has_astrolabe
- the Watch seal ring    -> has_seal_ring
- the almshouse ledger   -> has_ledger

PLACES (canonical fact name for "the player can enter"):
- the Old Customs Yard -> customs_yard_open
- the Watch barracks   -> barracks_open

Use these exact fact names. All start false except alive_oren_vask, alive_hallowell and alive_dunmore, which start true.

quests.title: The Pawnbroker's Price
quests.prose:
1. Infiltrate the Watch barracks and secure Captain Hallowell's authority.
You must gain entry to the Watch barracks to find a leverage point against Saltmarrow's most stubborn fence. Search the captain's quarters to obtain the Watch seal ring, which will grant you the official backing of the Iron Watch.

2. Retrieve the almshouse ledger from Sister Dunmore.
Seek out Sister Dunmore at the parish house and convince her to hand over the almshouse ledger. This book contains the damning record of Oren Vask's predatory debts, but she will only trust you once you show her the Watch seal ring.

3. Gain entry to the Old Customs Yard to locate Oren's hidden cache.
With the law on your side, force open the gates to the Old Customs Yard where the pawnbroker stores his smuggled goods. Search the salt-crusted warehouses to find the manifest detailing his latest acquisitions.

4. Confront Oren Vask on Fishmonger's Pier to reclaim the Sunburst Astrolabe.
Corner the greedy pawnbroker at his shop on Fishmonger's Pier and present the ledger and the seal ring. Faced with the threat of Captain Hallowell's dungeons, Oren Vask will have no choice but to yield the Sunburst Astrolabe.

quests.title: The Iron Purge of Saltmarrow
quests.prose:
1. Gain entry to the Watch barracks and speak with Captain Hallowell to secure your commission. The commander of the Iron Watch requires an outsider to bypass the bureaucratic rot of Saltmarrow and initiate a purge of the lower slips.

2. Confront Oren Vask on Fishmonger's Pier and seize the Sunburst Astrolabe. This rare, forbidden navigational instrument is being used by contraband traders to guide illicit cargo vessels through the treacherous coastal reefs.

3. Obtain the almshouse ledger from Sister Dunmore to trace the smugglers' black-market funding. Though she maintains a pious facade, her records hold the secret accounts that keep the criminal enterprise afloat.

4. Unlock the Old Customs Yard using the Watch seal ring and eliminate the remaining syndicate leaders. Clearing this fortified hideout will break the smugglers' grip on Saltmarrow once and for all.

quests.title: The Ledger of Lies
quests.prose: 1. Speak with Oren Vask at Fishmonger's Pier to learn of the corruption hidden within the city's charity records. Oren suspects that the almshouse is being used to launder stolen coin, but he needs proof to convince the authorities. 2. Infiltrate the almshouse and secure the almshouse ledger from Sister Dunmore, who guards the records with suspicious fervor. You must retrieve the book without alerting the Iron Watch to your presence. 3. Present the incriminating ledger to Captain Hallowell at the Watch barracks to expose the fraud. With the evidence in hand, the Captain will be forced to dismantle the illicit operation and restore order to Saltmarrow.

quests.title: The Seal of Saltmarrow
quests.prose:
1. Search the Old Customs Yard for the Sunburst Astrolabe.
Oren Vask claims this priceless relic lies forgotten in the locked yard. Slip past the rusted gates of the Old Customs Yard and recover the astrolabe before the port authority notices.

2. Trade the Sunburst Astrolabe to Sister Dunmore for the almshouse ledger.
Sister Dunmore keeps the ledger under lock and key, but her obsession with celestial navigation makes her weak to bribery. Offer her the astrolabe in exchange for the ledger containing the Watch's blackmail secrets.

3. Use the ledger's secrets to gain entry to the Watch barracks.
The ledger details the illicit debts of Captain Hallowell's gate-guards. Confront the sentry with this evidence to secure passage into the heavily guarded Watch barracks.

4. Steal the Watch seal ring from Captain Hallowell's chambers.
With the barracks open, slip into the inner sanctum while the Captain is away. Snatch the Watch seal ring from his writing desk and escape into the Saltmarrow fog.
